intro: Today, let's play a shadow game!
Look at the shadow, and guess the animal. Ready?

items.name: Elephant
items.hint: It has a long, long trunk!

items.name: Giraffe
items.hint: It has a very long neck!

items.name: Rabbit
items.hint: It has long ears and goes hop, hop!

items.name: Turtle
items.hint: It carries its house on its back!

items.name: Butterfly
items.hint: It has pretty wings and flies from flower to flower!

items.name: Rooster
items.hint: It says cock-a-doodle-doo in the morning!
items.fact: Roosters wake us up in the morning!

items.name: Cat
items.fact: Cats love to sleep and play!

seo.title: Guess the Animal by its Shadow! 🐘🦒 Shadow Game for Kids | Learn Animal Names | Unique Kiddo
seo.description:
Can your little one guess the animal from its shadow? 🤔 Play along with Kiddo! Look at the shadow, listen to the clue, think, and shout the answer!

In this fun learning game for kids, children learn 8 animal names:
🐘 Elephant
🦒 Giraffe
🐇 Rabbit
🐢 Turtle
🦋 Butterfly
🐓 Rooster
🐟 Fish
🐈 Cat

Each round has think time so kids can guess, and a "say it with me" pause to practise new English words. Great for toddlers, preschool and kindergarten (ages 2–6).

⭐ Subscribe to Unique Kiddo for more fun learning games: colours, numbers, fruits, vehicles and more!

Voice: Kokoro TTS (Apache 2.0) · Emoji art: Noto Emoji (Apache 2.0)
